issues.description: Lecture.addGuestStudents has an API mismatch: the problem statement/UML specifies addGuestStudents(int): void, and the reference solution implements public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents), but the template already declares public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput). The extra boolean parameter changes the required public method signature and will prevent students from matching the expected API/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to match the specified API by changing the method to `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... }` and remove the boolean parameter (any validation, if desired, should be internal and not change the public signature).
